design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER - task 1 (move_out_deposit_accounting, M=2, final task) - revision 2 (after the source-layer audit, see [13])

[0] Draw and scope snapshot. draw_counts.py --task 1 printed: {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 6, 5, 5]}. Design: root deposit_ext_guarantee_gap_payment (5 factors) with three prerequisite problems - deposit_ext_carpet_depreciation_credit (6), deposit_ext_repair_labor_credit (5), deposit_ext_fob_count_credit (4). Occupied by task 0: deposit_ext_cleaning_correction_credit + post_cleaning_correction_credit_249da733, deposit_ext_settlement_payment + pay_settlement_balance_cadbabf4 (cash-deposit settlement, cleaning lines). Claimed here: the carpet, repair and fob line families and the Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan gap payment, with tools post_depreciation_correction_credit_f675d6ed, post_repair_labor_credit_05a989cb, post_fob_count_credit_b88884f4, pay_guarantee_gap_4e6273ca. No overlap; together the two tasks cover all six extended policies and all six tools; nothing is reserved.

[1] Why this is a good test. The resident asks only to pay the part the guarantee won't cover. To get it right the agent must read the gap-payment rule's three prerequisite sentences, find three accepted disputes (carpet, repair, fobs) with no credits on the ledger, work out that each is resolved by exactly one correction policy, compute three credits from fifteen record-driven rules (occupants, the dog registered as an assistance animal, the carpet's age band choosing the depreciation convention, tenancy + late fees, floor-plan cost cap, room traffic; tenancy + returned payments, itemization timing + photos, room of the repair, notice on the completed last term, dispute promptness; tenancy fob forgiveness, garage parking product, autopay + insurance, statement timing choosing how the fobs are reckoned), post them, and then compute the guarantee coverage from five more (premium terms, co-leaseholders, how the completed last term came about, premium lapse, the utility balance sharing the limit). One write per problem; each credit policy names its own line family.

[2] Problem-tree card. Root deposit_ext_guarantee_gap_payment (owner=user, on_request). Edges (all value_input, gate gap_credited, form state): carpet ('The guarantee gap payment is taken only after every carpet replacement line under an accepted dispute carries its dispute credit on the account.'), repair ('The guarantee gap payment is not taken until every damage repair line under an accepted dispute carries its dispute credit on the account.'), fob ('Before the guarantee gap payment is taken, every unreturned-fob line under an accepted dispute must carry its dispute credit on the account.'). Four-point test on each: ordering connective (only after / not until / before), each rewritable into the other direction without changing its condition; a record-visible state (accepted dispute on a line of that family + a dispute credit sourced on it); no tool, id or code token; scope = the edge condition. Directions are mixed across the charter. Exactly one write of the difficulty sources a credit on each family. False at the opening: disputes 20853ec0-e85c-43c4-9a8a-d9f35d2cc75c, 5be87ef8-7fc7-4ba7-bdb6-a4d5eb8f7207, a2cf57df-c7e0-46c9-ac93-791bf6852b2a accepted on lines 387a5672-39e6-4c49-8b55-dd00afa919fe, 427d2128-0805-4293-9a05-c42c68fe4690, 1faf6a33-fa15-4a7f-9762-e1ba7da6b68f; no deposit_balance_credit row. Order: carpet (step 9), repair (13), fob (16), payment (19); the credits commute (recomputed on the world after the other two: 1238.00 / 226.50 / 145.00 unchanged). Deletion sensitivity: skip carpet -> 1329.34, skip repair -> 317.84, skip fob -> 236.34 (vs 91.34). 3 value_input edges >= max(3-1,1) = 2. The persona names no prerequisite; the tools validate nothing.

[3] Base-invariant card. Credit subject deposit_balance_credit: deposit_disputes_and_amendment and deposit_balance_and_collections, both policy_scope (their gates govern reversal, reopen and referral only). Payment subject deposit_balance_payment: deposit_balance_and_collections, policy_scope. No time gate; the disputes were accepted inside the window (statement 2026-08-31, window to 2026-09-30); no guarantee claim before 2026-09-30 + 30 days. Overrides: each correction policy supersedes 'withdraws the line in full' for its own family and the base sentence for its computation (carpet depreciation; damage_repair labor; unreturned fobs quantity x charge); the gap policy supersedes the claim's coverage clause so the payment and the later claim share one coverage. Term seed follows the term charter (audit O-15): the month-to-month conversion carries contracted_rent 2362.50 (1890.00 x (1 + rent_adjustment_pct 0.25), above the 200.00 floor), but no rent-change notice was given, so the in-place 1890.00 continued (the July 2026 autopay is 1890.00) and leases.monthly_rent stays 1890.00 - the 'monthly rent without the month-to-month premium' the coverage-rent rule reads.

[4] Business-object card. Account 9664a781-713f-43d6-99b1-afa9fbd0b028 (Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan, WA, lease ce3db3d7-5a86-4f3e-ac2c-dddd243f7062). Credit objects: carpet line 387a5672-39e6-4c49-8b55-dd00afa919fe, repair line 427d2128-0805-4293-9a05-c42c68fe4690, fob line 1faf6a33-fa15-4a7f-9762-e1ba7da6b68f - each the line its accepted dispute names, each the only line of its category. Excluded: cleaning, paint, appliance, flooring, trash lines (undisputed, not recomputed). Gap object: the balance owed 157fb595-494e-488c-b0f8-701d3fb3b6ad 4098.94 less the 500.00 payment 922b70aa-a865-43c1-8703-4ff96bd9d5e9 and the three credits. The four premium rows 45b674e4-d460-433b-ad15-d6a41b990ae1, 396d35e6-4785-43dd-8270-7eef9bf57eb5, d40eceeb-9ca0-4cf7-a2aa-ab18fa2be1cb, 7aad826a-c770-47d1-88e0-0b785ff05af0 feed only the coverage.

[5] Factor card (expected / per-factor baseline results / whole baseline).
 Carpet credit 1238.00: occupancy_carpet_life (param, lease: 3 occupants -> 54; baseline 60 -> 1157.33); animal_carpet_life_cut (param, pet: a dog registered as an assistance animal, 'as a pet or as an assistance animal' -> 6; baseline 0 -> 1157.33); carpet_age_band (method: 30/48 = 0.625 -> whole-year convention, age rounded up to 36, remaining 12/48 = 0.25; the declining convention would square the straight-line share, the young band keeps straight-line; baseline straight-line on 30 months, 0.375 -> 1117.00); tenancy_carpet_wear_allowance (param, multi-source, lease: 53 months, no late fee within 24 months -> 0.12; near-miss 2024-09-05 at exactly 24 months; baseline 0 -> 1205.00); like_for_like_carpet_cost (param, lease: One-Bedroom Den -> cap 1250.00 vs 1480.00; baseline 1480 -> 1193.47); carpet_room_traffic (param: living_room -> 0.88; baseline 1 -> 1205.00). 1250 x 0.25 x 0.88 x 0.88 = 242.00; 1480 - 242 = 1238.00; whole baseline 1480 x 30/60 -> 740.00.
 Repair credit 226.50 (unchanged): tenancy_labor_rate 52.00 (baseline 191.40); documented_billable_hours method 3.5 -> 3 (203.10); repaired_room_parts_share 0.80 (212.10); notice_labor_discount 0.10, notice 2026-06-05 on the completed last term (210.90); prompt_dispute_goodwill 20.00 (206.50); whole baseline 105.00.
 Fob credit 145.00 (revision 3): fobs held are a plain rule, the honest baseline: 3 issued at move-in + 1 bought (key-fob fees 75.00 / key_fob_replacement_fee 75.00) + 1 gate fob issued with the Structured Garage Space license = 5, so the recorded 5 are all countable. Factors: tenancy_fob_forgiveness (param, lease: 53 months >= 48 -> 1 fob forgiven; 24-47 months would forgive half a fob, shorter tenancies none; baseline 0 -> 50.00); parking_access_fob_charge (param, parking: garage -> 95.00; baseline 75.00 -> 205.00); good_order_fob_courtesy (param, multi-source, lease: autopay and insurance -> 55.00; baseline 0 -> 90.00); statement_timing_fob_reckoning (method: statement 24 days after move-out -> one fob fewer, 5 -> 4; past 25 days would halve and round down, within 20 counts as counted; baseline as counted -> 50.00). (4 - 1) x 95 - 55 = 230.00; 375 - 230 = 145.00; whole baseline 5 x 75 = 375 -> 0.00 (the base itemization reading: the line as charged).
 Gap payment 91.34: premium_terms_multiple 2.00 (baseline 563.84); co_leaseholder_step 0.10 (185.84); tenancy_end_coverage_rent method, completed last term a month-to-month conversion -> 1890.00 (baseline move-in 1720.00 -> 269.84); premium_continuity_share 0.50 (baseline 1 -> 0.00); shared_ledger_limit method, utility 86.40 (baseline 0 -> 4.94). Coverage 1898.10; standing 4098.94 - 500 - 1609.50 = 1989.44; gap 91.34; whole baseline 0.00.
 Rounding: all figures were checked for exact half-cent ties; the traffic and allowance params (0.88 / 0.12) were chosen so no computed figure falls on one.

[6] Rule <-> compute sweep. Every reading/choosing binding quotes a verbatim rule sentence (check_extended). Reverse: the carpet age-band sentence (declining / whole-year / straight-line conventions) -> worn_share, remaining_share; the fobs-held sentence (issued + fees billed / key_fob_replacement_fee + one gate fob when a parking license was held) -> fobs_issued, fob_fees_billed, fobs_bought, holds_parking_license, fob_allotment (plain, not a factor); the forgiveness ladder -> fob_tenure_months, forgiven_fobs; the reckoning sentence (halved and rounded down / one fewer, never below none / as counted) -> statement_lag_days, reckoned_fobs; closing sentences -> corrected_carpet, corrected_fob. Repair and gap as in revision 1.

[7] initial_state. As in revision 1, with the month-to-month term at contracted_rent 2362.50 and the July 2026 autopay at the in-place 1890.00 (O-15). Replay closure 35/35. No obligation outside the tree.

[8] Persona. Unchanged: goal (pay the part the guarantee won't cover today), phone, SSN on request, disputes only if asked, passive hand-over, pays from checking (ach_one_time), ends at the confirmation.

[9] Reachability walk: unchanged (frozen 2026-09-18 10:05 PDT), with the carpet credit 1238.00 and the gap payment 91.34.

[10] Uniqueness: unchanged for identifiers; computed 1238.00, 226.50, 145.00, 91.34.

[11] Verification (revision 2): per-task gates for task 1 all green (EXTENDED OK; REPLAY OK 20 actions closure 35/35; SOLVABILITY OK; COMPUTE OK; GROUNDING OK), then the full difficulty block (EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, CACHE-DIFF INFO, SCOPE OK; traceability deferred to render).

[12] Draft recalculation from the visible context: three sentences -> three accepted disputes -> three correction policies; carpet prose (whole-year band) -> 242.00 -> 1238.00; repair -> 226.50; fob prose (4 held, one fewer for a 24-day statement) -> 230.00 -> 145.00; gap -> 1989.44 - 1898.10 = 91.34. Same as gold.

[13] Revisions. Round 1: repair overwrite replaced_by trimmed; garage/EV fob rates set so no baseline is negative; assistance dog chosen so no pet deposit sits on the guarantee account.
Round 2 (audits/policy_task/move_out_deposit_accounting/1.md and _difficulty.md):
 F-2 carpet (carpet_age_band mislabelled method) - change: the band now selects the depreciation convention: declining (straight-line share squared) at 75% of life or more, whole-year (age rounded up to whole years) at 50-75%, straight-line monthly below; the decides binding is remaining_share, baseline straight-line; carpet credit 1226.00 -> 1238.00 (with traffic 0.88 and allowance 0.12 to keep every figure off a half-cent tie).
 F-2 fob (statement_timing_fob_share mislabelled method) - change: renamed statement_timing_fob_reckoning; the tiers now change how the fobs are counted: halved and rounded down / one fewer, never below none / as counted.
 F-3 fob (unreachable allotment tier) - change: the ladder is now fobs bought -> issued + bought; no fob bought but a parking license held -> issued + one gate fob; neither -> the floor plan's issued fobs (the baseline, a treatment real households receive). O-6 folded in: fobs bought = key-fob fees billed on the lease ledger / key_fob_replacement_fee, so one line billing several fobs counts them all.
 Gap payment 103.34 -> 91.34 through the larger carpet credit; skip-one figures 1329.34 / 317.84 / 236.34.
 Observations: O-15 fixed in the seed (see [3]); O-16 - the carpet rule now says 'a dog was registered on the lease, as a pet or as an assistance animal'; O-17 - the three credits commute and order_uniqueness says so; the listed gold order is one of the equivalent orders; O-5 - the repair and gap rules now say 'the lease's completed last term'; O-6, O-7, O-8 handled as in the task-0 dossier [13].
Round 3 (audit revision_2 in audits/policy_task/move_out_deposit_accounting/1.md and _difficulty.md):
 N-1 (unreal compound condition in household_fob_allotment: a bought fob made the license's gate fob drop out) - root cause: the round-2 ladder made 'no fob was bought' part of the gate-fob tier only to keep the tiers disjoint. Change: the fobs the household held are now one plain rule stated in the baseline paragraph - fobs issued at move-in + fobs bought (fees billed / key_fob_replacement_fee) + gate_fobs_with_license gate fob when a parking license was held - so this household holds 3 + 1 + 1 = 5. The allotment factor is removed; the drawn count of 4 is kept by a new tenancy_fob_forgiveness factor (lease: 48+ months forgives 1 fob, 24-47 months half a fob, otherwise none), taken off the reckoned fobs. The dispute ground reads 'fob charge was misapplied' (the recorded count of 5 is within the fobs held). Result: fob credit 145.00 (5 held, 4 reckoned, 1 forgiven, 3 x 95.00 - 55.00 = 230.00), gap payment unchanged at 91.34; per-factor baselines 50.00 / 205.00 / 90.00 / 50.00, whole baseline 0.00.
 O-18 (floor-plan order for 'next smaller') - the cleaning rule now states the order from smallest to largest. O-19 (ceiling at an exact multiple of 12) - the carpet rule now says the age is rounded up to a whole multiple of age_year_months months, an age already on a whole multiple staying as it is (task-1 carpet age 30 is unaffected). O-3, O-4, O-9, O-10, O-11, O-12, O-17 remain accepted observations.
user_scenario: You are Joaquin Mireles, 33, a QA engineer who lived in apartment 4-146 at Larkspur Bellevue Station with your partner, your daughter and Otto, your assistance dog, from March 2022 until you moved out on August 7. You never paid a cash deposit: you were on the zero-deposit guarantee plan the whole time. You are careful and a little anxious, you speak in complete sentences, and you want this handled properly rather than quickly. You call because you understand the guarantee will pick up part of what you owe after moving out, and you want to pay the part the guarantee won't cover, today, so that nothing of yours ends up with a collection agency. You start by giving your mobile number, 425-554-6031. When they ask you to verify, you give the last four of your Social Security number, 4152; if they need something more you give your date of birth, January 27, 1993. You remember that the final statement arrived at the end of August and that you already paid 500 dollars toward it on September 10 with your credit card; beyond that you would rather they read the numbers than guess them yourself. Only if the agent asks whether you disputed anything do you explain that you disputed three lines in the portal right after the statement came - the living-room carpet, the kitchen repair and the charge for five fobs - and that you later received emails saying all three disputes were accepted; you do not know what each one is worth and you say so. If the agent tells you that some things have to be recorded on their side before your payment, you tell them to go ahead and you wait patiently. When the agent gives you the amount and hands you the payment step, you will pay it straight from your checking account, in exactly the amount and on the account they give you, and you read back the confirmation number the portal shows. If they ask how you want to pay, you say from your checking account, not a card this time. You do not ask for anything else. Once the payment has gone through and you have the confirmation number, you thank the agent and hang up.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The three credits are parallel prerequisites of the gap payment (a fan-out). They commute: each credit's computation reads only its own line, the lease, term, pet and parking records and the statement and dispute dates - never the credited total or another credit - so any order of the three writes computes 1238.00, 226.50 and 145.00 and lands the same three rows (row ids are content hashes of account, source line and amount). Verified by recomputing each credit on the opening world and on the world after the other two credits: identical values. The only order the policies fix is that every credit precedes the gap payment, stated by its three prerequisite sentences; the payment alone reads the credited total.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the step-9 credit and replaying everything else, gap_credited falls by 1238.00 and the guarantee gap payment recomputes to 1329.34 instead of 91.34 (coverage 1898.10 is unchanged); the terminal ledger also lacks the 1238.00 credit row.

Skipping the step-13 credit and replaying everything else, gap_credited falls by 226.50 and the guarantee gap payment recomputes to 317.84 instead of 91.34 (coverage 1898.10 is unchanged); the terminal ledger also lacks the 226.50 credit row.

Skipping the step-16 credit and replaying everything else, gap_credited falls by 145.00 and the guarantee gap payment recomputes to 236.34 instead of 91.34 (coverage 1898.10 is unchanged); the terminal ledger also lacks the 145.00 credit row.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The scenario asks only to pay the part the guarantee will not cover so nothing goes to collections. It never names a credit, a correction or anything that must happen first. The three disputes come up only if the agent asks whether anything was disputed, as the resident's own portal filings and acceptance emails, with 'you do not know what each one is worth and you say so'. His one prerequisite-related line is passive: 'If the agent tells you that some things have to be recorded on their side before your payment, you tell them to go ahead and you wait patiently.'
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: pay_guarantee_gap_4e6273ca reads the account only to copy its customer_id and then writes the payment row unconditionally; post_depreciation_correction_credit_f675d6ed, post_repair_labor_credit_05a989cb and post_fob_count_credit_b88884f4 each write one credit row unconditionally. None checks disputes, other credits, balances or dates, none raises, and each returns its receipt whether or not the other problems were resolved.
